# markdown-it

Vendored build-time renderer: markdown-it 15.0.2, MIT licensed.
Source: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/markdown-it/v/15.0.2

The static blog builder uses this standalone ESM build. It is not loaded by visitors and requires no npm install. Keep LICENSE alongside the file when updating it.
